eyebrow: Staging: raw strings become typed columns
code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE staging.orders AS
SELECT order_id, customer_id,
       TRY_CAST(order_date AS DATE) AS order_date,
       TRY_CAST(quantity AS NUMBER) AS quantity,
       TRY_CAST(unit_price AS NUMBER(10,2)) AS unit_price
FROM raw.sqlserver_orders
WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL;
caption: TRY_CAST turns a bad row into a findable NULL, not a failed build.
